content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Go Memory Allocator Architecture (Arenas, Spans, Mcache, Mcentral, Mheap)"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Go's multi-tiered memory allocator manages heap memory hierarchically using Arenas, Spans, mcache, mcentral, and mheap to minimize lock contention and fragmentation."}]
